scopesAndNuances.text: Development Mode quota is counted per developer account, not per Client ID. All your Development Mode apps share one budget.
A developer account can have up to 25 Client IDs (raised from 1).
When the quota is exceeded, the 429 response body includes "reason": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED". Rate-limit 429s do not carry this reason.
Spotify Open Access is a separate partner API for approved partners only, with Client IDs allow-listed by Partner Management. It does not clearly apply to a standard Web API agent.

The Android auth-lib is a Beta library that returns an authorization code through the Spotify client. It requires an application fingerprint and falls back to a web login if Spotify is not installed. It is only relevant if your agent has an Android client.
The provider's published OAuth metadata lists: 3 scope(s) listed; PKCE: S256; no registration endpoint is listed.
